## [Fastino Releases GLiNER2.5: A Boundary-Prediction Architecture That Removes Span Enumeration From Information Extraction](https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/08/24/fastino-releases-gliner2-5-a-boundary-prediction-architecture-that-removes-span-enumeration-from-information-extraction/)
*MarkTechPost* | 24/08/2026 | Score: 0.80
Tags: research_paper, model_release, architecture, hardware, open_source

> Fastino released GLiNER2.5, replacing span enumeration with boundary prediction so entity width no longer costs compute. Three Apache 2.0 checkpoints ship at 74M, 194M, and 287M parameters, all CPU-runnable. The release adds joint entity-relation decoding, constrained classification, span attributes, and 4,096-word context. Overall macro F1 reaches 56.17 on 16 zero-shot benchmarks. The post Fastino Releases GLiNER2.5: A Boundary-Prediction Architecture That Removes Span Enumeration From Information Extraction appeared first on MarkTechPost .
